svg.title: Voltstream: one simulated day
svg.desc: Sequence diagram. Every 2 s meters publish readings; the archiver appends them to MinIO and the speed layer upserts estimates. A bill request returns the estimate. At simulated midnight the tariff feed drops tariff D; Airflow polls, waits 90 s, rescans the day and commits bills with a success row, or marks the run failed and retries. After reconciliation, the same request returns the final bill.
